vt.analysis:
Type: OpenClaw Skill
Name: remotion-word-highlight-subtitles
Version: 0.1.3

The skill bundle provides a legitimate workflow for generating word-level highlighted subtitles using Whisper and Remotion. The included Python script (scripts/whisper_json_to_captions.py) is a utility for transforming transcription data, and the SKILL.md instructions guide the agent through standard video processing steps (ffprobe, whisper, ffmpeg). No evidence of data exfiltration, malicious persistence, or harmful prompt injection was found.

llm.summary: This appears to be a coherent local video-subtitling skill; users should mainly notice that it runs local media/rendering tools and leaves transcript/output files on disk.

dimensions.detail: The declared purpose—adding word-level highlighted subtitles to local videos—matches the required tools, workflow, README, and bundled caption-conversion script.
dimensions.label: Purpose & Capability
dimensions.name: purpose_capability

dimensions.detail: The skill instructs the agent to run ffprobe, Whisper, ffmpeg, Python, and Remotion-related commands and to write outputs next to the source video. This is purpose-aligned but should remain tied to a user-provided video path.
dimensions.label: Instruction Scope
dimensions.name: instruction_scope

dimensions.detail: There is no install spec, and the registry source/homepage are not provided. The workflow depends on locally installed binaries and Remotion/npm project dependencies, so users should ensure those tools are trusted.
dimensions.label: Install Mechanism
dimensions.name: install_mechanism

dimensions.detail: The skill reads local video/audio content and may use folder/file names or visible context to improve transcription. This is proportionate for subtitle generation but may involve private media content.
dimensions.label: Credentials
dimensions.name: environment_proportionality

dimensions.detail: The skill creates persistent local artifacts such as Whisper JSON, captions.json, copied/encoded input video files, and rendered output video. No credentials, background service, or privilege escalation are shown.
dimensions.label: Persistence & Privilege
dimensions.name: persistence_privilege

llm.guidance: This skill looks reasonable for local subtitle generation. Before installing or using it, make sure the required local tools are from trusted sources, provide only the video path you want processed, confirm where output files will be written, and delete intermediate transcript/caption files if the video contains sensitive speech.

evidence.explanation: The skill explicitly instructs the agent to execute local media, Python, and rendering commands. This is central to the stated video-subtitling purpose, but it is still local code/tool execution.
evidence.snippet: Run Whisper word timestamp transcription... Convert the Whisper JSON... Build or reuse a small Remotion project... Render with Remotion to the output path

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Use the skill only on video paths you intend to process, review output paths before rendering, and keep the required local tools updated and trusted.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: The agent will run local command-line tools and rendering workflows on the selected video, which can consume CPU/GPU time and create or overwrite output files if paths are reused.

evidence.explanation: The skill relies on preinstalled local tooling and likely Remotion/npm project dependencies, while the registry metadata does not provide a source or homepage. This is not inherently unsafe, but it limits provenance review.
evidence.snippet: Source: unknown; Homepage: none; No install spec — this is an instruction-only skill; Required binaries: python3, ffmpeg, ffprobe, whisper, node, npm

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Install required tools from trusted sources, avoid running the workflow inside untrusted existing npm projects, and review any generated or reused Remotion project dependencies.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Security depends partly on the local Whisper, ffmpeg, Node/npm, and Remotion environment used to run the workflow.

evidence.explanation: The workflow creates persistent transcript and caption files derived from the user's local video/audio content. This is expected for subtitle rendering, but those files may contain sensitive speech or context.
evidence.snippet: Transcribes a local video with Whisper `word_timestamps`... Converts Whisper's word-level JSON into Remotion-friendly `captions.json`... Writes the rendered video next to the source file.

agenticRiskFindings.recommendation: Process sensitive videos in a controlled folder, delete intermediate Whisper JSON/captions files when no longer needed, and avoid sharing the Remotion project folder unless you intend to share the transcript.
agenticRiskFindings.userImpact: Private audio content from the video may remain on disk in JSON caption/transcript files and in copied or rendered video outputs.

abnormal_behavior_control.summary: The skill runs local media/rendering commands and depends on external local tooling, but this is disclosed and aligned with its subtitle-rendering purpose.

permission_boundary.summary: No credentials, account access, delegated privileges, or protected-session use are shown in the supplied artifacts.

sensitive_data_protection.summary: The workflow stores local transcript/caption artifacts derived from the user's video; no upload or exfiltration behavior is shown.
